name: Seeblick
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnung Seeblick is located on the eastern shore of the Thiersee with a view of the water and the surrounding mountains. The building is in a quiet residential area, about a ten-minute walk from the center. Guests reach the lake in a few minutes on foot. The apartment is functionally furnished and offers a balcony or a terrace. Thiersee is a good starting point for hikes in the Bayerischen Wald and for excursions to nearby Liechtenstein or to the Schweiz.
